title: Atlassian API token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T2]
summary: Synthetic Atlassian API token values built to the documented format appear in 10 inputs across 10 carrier types. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (open-source scanner rule); claim not itemised.

incidents.summary: atlassian-api-token leaves the '=' + 8-hex suffix of 192-character tokens unredacted (partial redaction)
